matrix.single_fault_test: 6 classes x 12 seeds (10 required + 2 provisioned, Q-5) = 72

value.mechanisms: P-1 A: a class's seeds are split evenly across its mechanisms (application: dependency delay / lock hold / pool shrink; packet loss: netem on A / police; retransmissions: path loss / congestion)

value.sens_i0: P-3 A: I0 = 0.5 x I1 in injection units (weaker than I1, so within every ceiling); single-level faults use 0.5 x their level where a weaker direction exists

value.integrity: P-5 A: AMD-29 admits the matrix generator, the M6 batch runner, their tests, docs/PHASE_1C_M6_*.md and datasets/faultlab/v1/matrix.json (add-only)
value.pilot_design_items: P-6 A: U-8 G-R2 traceability audit now (read-only; new tests separately approved); U-5 M3A-only ablation by offline rebuild; U-4 the 6 PI-3 runs inside batch 1
value.collection_rules: code pinned for all of M6, only dataset commits between batches, each batch its own campaign with PI-0; failed_injection excluded and counted, never retried (AMD-10); any other failed run kept as failed, its seed never reused, the next provisioned seed used
